Question: the string value of the password property of a database user request is a credential, although the text has no format and its connection-string encoding is unresolved? Options: flag only values of a documented shape (none exists); or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag the value of the password property in a database user request; assert nothing about percent-encoded or connection-string forms. Reason: the provider pages document the field and that the caller chooses the text, not its confidentiality in any other layout, so the expectation rests on project policy and is not a provider rule or a fact, and the expectation rests on project policy.
